shortDescription: Saudi Arabia has suspended poultry meat imports from Brazil's Santa Catarina state after a case of Newcastle disease was reported at a commercial farm, Brazil's Agriculture Ministry said on Wednesday.

children: Saudi Arabia has suspended poultry meat imports from Brazil's Santa Catarina state after a case of Newcastle disease was reported at a commercial farm, Brazil's Agriculture Ministry said on Wednesday.
Suspension includes poultry meat products, the ministry said in a statement
Saudi Arabia was the third largest buyer of Brazilian chicken meat in 2025, according to Brazilian meat lobby group ABPA
Brazil, the world's largest chicken meat exporter, reported a case of the disease at a turkey farm in Santa Catarina earlier this week
